trust_decision.summary: A source row belongs to exactly one project, and reading/mutating it must be gated on the caller's project; the project id arrives on the request, but the SQL fetch keys only on the source id, so the boundary can only be enforced by the caller of FetchSourceByID.

landing_point.why: The advisory is 'cross-tenant source IDOR leaks broker credentials'; an engineer starts at the project-scoped source read handler GetSource, which passes project.UID into FindSourceByID.

fix_sites.module_kind: service/repository layer over sqlc Postgres queries (internal/sources)

fix_sites.entry_point: POST logout (BlacklistToken) and access-token validation (isTokenBlacklisted/ValidateAccessToken) - this is GHSA-hpqj-2j2x-p5p2, a different advisory carried by the same commit
fix_sites.module_kind: auth realm (jwt), unrelated to this advisory

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The only unscoped source read left is FindSourceByMaskID (internal/sources/impl.go:467), and a solver can reasonably call it out of scope: the ingest route is unauthenticated by design, the mask id is the capability itself, and the handler (api/ingest.go:41,448) never returns the source row to the caller.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Mask-id lookup must stay project-agnostic: the unauthenticated ingest/CRC routes know only the mask id (uniuri.NewLen(16)) and have no project to scope to; pushing project scoping into the shared row mapper or the SQL fetch used by both would break ingestion for every project.

O6_input_shapes: source id as URL path segment (GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{projectID}/sources/{sourceID})
source_id inside the JSON request body (create/update subscription)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET/POST /ingest/{maskID} reads the same source row without any project scope
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the ingest route is public and the mask id is the capability; there is no authenticated project to scope to, and the row is never returned to the requester, so scoping it would only break ingestion
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (internal/sources) as the fix, called from a different package (api)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second fetch-by-single-identifier query (e.g. FetchSourceByExternalID) whose WHERE omits project_id while its siblings scope in SQL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already mixes scoped (FetchSourceByName line 178, DeleteSource line 374) and unscoped (FetchSourceByID line 145, FetchSourceByMaskID line 211) lookups, so a maintainer adding another lookup would plausibly copy the wrong one

O8b_injection_room.sibling: UpdateSource accepts projectID but uses it only as the new column value, never as a WHERE filter, so the write path itself is unscoped
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix comment itself points at DeleteSourceByID scoping in SQL while UpdateSource does not; a maintainer refactoring the update path could easily reintroduce a cross-project write

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cached source wrapper keyed only on the source id (like the subscription wrapper here) that returns a cached row for another project's id
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the repo already wraps subscription lookups in datastore/cached; adding the same cache in front of sources without a project component in the key is a natural performance change

O9_family: IDOR / missing tenant authorization on object lookup (CWE-639)

services: postgres (testenv launches docker-backed test infrastructure in internal/sources/test_helpers_test.go:29-46)
O10_build.project_tests: internal/sources/get_source_test.go:237-262 TestFindSource_VerifiesProjectScope already documents that FindSourceByID does not enforce project scope; the fix rewrites it and adds TestJwt_BlacklistToken_AlternateSpellingBypass in auth/realm/jwt/jwt_test.go

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the project check in the GetSource handler (or filter by project in the handler) and stop there, leaving PUT/DELETE and the two subscription call sites on the unscoped shared service.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit also closes an unrelated JWT blacklist-key canonicalization advisory (GHSA-hpqj-2j2x-p5p2, auth/realm/jwt/jwt.go:132-134); it shares no sink with this advisory and its added test would not be derivable from a source-IDOR report.
